opus.problem: The best-known part of the story is missing: Delilah lulling Samson to sleep on her knees and having a man shave off his seven braids (Judges 16:19). The set uses minor attempts instead.

Nearly the same fact as clue 1: she tied Samson with something new or fresh and he snapped it. One of the two should be swapped for a different fact, such as her home in the Valley of Sorek (Judges 16:4) or the shaving of his head (Judges 16:19).

Every clue names Samson, and most mention the secret of his strength. Delilah is the only well-known woman tied to that, so almost any single clue (clue 2 especially) gives the word away on its own. They are too easy for medium hard.
